The backlash underscores a growing tension in the AI field between the drive for innovation and the implementation of safety measures that some feel are overly restrictive and paternalistic.

The jailbreaking of an advanced AI model like Fable 5 has set off alarm bells throughout the cryptocurrency sector. Curve Finance co-founder Michael Egorov suggested the risk might be overstated for smart contracts, whose code is typically short and more easily auditable by humans compared to vast enterprise software systems.
